text: グレン　じま　から　およいで　きたけど…　きついわ！

structure.jp: グレン　じま　から
およいで　きたけど…

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる says the action was done on the way to where the speaker is now. およいで きた = 'came here swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with a 'but'. きたけど = 'I came, but'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to add feeling to what you say. きついわ = 'it's tough!'
